vini_en.instruct: A real young Brazilian man, 26, talking casually in English with a natural Brazilian Portuguese accent. Very natural, human, conversational, relaxed and breathy, cocky and playful, a smile in his voice, varied intonation, like a funny vlog voice-over, not a narrator, not robotic.
vini_en.ref: Hey! You know who I am, right? Relax, today is going to be a beautiful day.

diom_en.instruct: Young man, nineteen years old, from Ivory Coast, speaking English with a soft West African French accent. Friendly, shy, light laugh in the voice, gentle mid-high voice.
diom_en.ref: Hey, thank you, my friend. It was a good game today, really.

sadie_en.instruct: Young American woman in her early twenties, clear bright voice, polite but cool and a little dry, slightly amused.
sadie_en.ref: Oh, hi. Thanks, but I already have plans tonight.

lines.text: I've never been jealous of Spider-Man.
But why be jealous? I'm Vinícius Júnior.
lines.emo: Smug, confident, laughing a little at the end.

lines.text: I invited her to see a real superhero. At the Bernabéu.
Ever since Diomande showed up... the bench is my best friend.
Thanks, bro. I'll take it from here.
